lines.hebrew: מָעוֹז צוּר יְשׁוּעָתִי, לְךָ נָאֶה לְשַׁבֵּחַ,
lines.translation: Stronghold, Rock of my salvation, to You [it is] fitting to praise,

clauses.translation: Stronghold, Rock of my salvation
to You [it is] fitting to praise

lines.hebrew: תִּכּוֹן בֵּית תְּפִלָּתִי, וְשָׁם תּוֹדָה נְזַבֵּחַ,
lines.translation: may the house of my prayer be established, and there we will sacrifice a thanksgiving offering,

clauses.translation: may the house of my prayer be established
and there we will sacrifice a thanksgiving offering

lines.hebrew: לְעֵת תָּכִין מַטְבֵּחַ, מִצָּר הַמְנַבֵּחַ,
lines.translation: when You prepare a slaughter of the barking foe,

clauses.translation: when You prepare a slaughter
of the barking foe

lines.hebrew: אָז אֶגְמֹר בְּשִׁיר מִזְמוֹר, חֲנֻכַּת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ.
lines.translation: then I will complete with a song of psalm the dedication of the altar.

clauses.translation: then I will complete with a song of psalm
the dedication of the altar

lines.hebrew: רָעוֹת שָׂבְעָה נַפְשִׁי, בְּיָגוֹן כֹּחִי כָּלָה,
lines.translation: My soul was sated with troubles, my strength was consumed with grief,

clauses.translation: My soul was sated with troubles
my strength was consumed with grief

lines.hebrew: חַיַּי מֵרְרוּ בְקֹשִׁי, בְּשִׁעְבּוּד מַלְכוּת עֶגְלָה,
lines.translation: they embittered my life with hardship, with the bondage of the kingdom of the Calf,

clauses.translation: they embittered my life with hardship
with the bondage of the kingdom of the Calf

lines.hebrew: וּבְיָדוֹ הַגְּדוֹלָה, הוֹצִיא אֶת הַסְּגֻלָּה,
lines.translation: and with His great hand He brought out the treasured people,

clauses.translation: and with His great hand
He brought out the treasured people

lines.hebrew: חֵיל פַּרְעֹה וְכָל זַרְעוֹ, יָרְדוּ כְּאֶבֶן מְצוּלָה.
lines.translation: the army of Pharaoh and all his offspring went down like a stone into the deep.

clauses.translation: the army of Pharaoh and all his offspring
went down like a stone into the deep

lines.hebrew: דְּבִיר קָדְשׁוֹ הֱבִיאַנִי, וְגַם שָׁם לֹא שָׁקַטְתִּי,
lines.translation: To the sanctuary of His holiness He brought me, and even there I had no rest,

clauses.translation: To the sanctuary of His holiness He brought me
and even there I had no rest

lines.hebrew: וּבָא נוֹגֵשׂ וְהִגְלַנִי, כִּי זָרִים עָבַדְתִּי,
lines.translation: and an oppressor came and exiled me, for I had served foreign gods,

clauses.translation: and an oppressor came and exiled me
for I had served foreign gods

lines.hebrew: וְיֵין רַעַל מָסַכְתִּי, כִּמְעַט שֶׁעָבַרְתִּי,
lines.translation: and I had mixed the wine of poison, I had almost perished,

clauses.translation: and I had mixed the wine of poison
I had almost perished

lines.hebrew: קֵץ בָּבֶל זְרֻבָּבֶל, לְקֵץ שִׁבְעִים נוֹשָׁעְתִּי.
lines.translation: at the end of Babylon, [with] Zerubbabel, at the end of seventy [years] I was saved.

clauses.translation: at the end of Babylon, [with] Zerubbabel
at the end of seventy [years] I was saved

lines.hebrew: כְּרֹת קוֹמַת בְּרוֹשׁ בִּקֵּשׁ, אֲגָגִי בֶּן הַמְּדָתָא,
lines.translation: [he] sought to cut down the stature of the cypress, the Agagite, son of Hammedatha,

clauses.translation: [he] sought to cut down the stature of the cypress
the Agagite, son of Hammedatha

lines.hebrew: וְנִהְיָתָה לוֹ לְפַח וּלְמוֹקֵשׁ, וְגַאֲוָתוֹ נִשְׁבָּתָה,
lines.translation: and it became for him a trap and a snare, and his arrogance was brought to an end,

clauses.translation: and it became for him a trap and a snare
and his arrogance was brought to an end

lines.hebrew: רֹאשׁ יְמִינִי נִשֵּׂאתָ, וְאוֹיֵב שְׁמוֹ מָחִיתָ,
lines.translation: the head of the Benjaminite You raised up, and the enemy, his name You blotted out,

clauses.translation: the head of the Benjaminite You raised up
and the enemy, his name You blotted out

lines.hebrew: רֹב בָּנָיו וְקִנְיָנָיו, עַל הָעֵץ תָּלִיתָ.
lines.translation: the multitude of his sons and his possessions You hanged on the gallows.

clauses.translation: the multitude of his sons and his possessions
You hanged on the gallows

lines.hebrew: יְוָנִים נִקְבְּצוּ עָלַי, אֲזַי בִּימֵי חַשְׁמַנִּים,
lines.translation: Greeks gathered against me, then, in the days of the Hasmoneans,

clauses.translation: Greeks gathered against me
then, in the days of the Hasmoneans

lines.hebrew: וּפָרְצוּ חוֹמוֹת מִגְדָּלַי, וְטִמְּאוּ כָּל הַשְּׁמָנִים,
lines.translation: and they breached the walls of my towers, and they defiled all the oils,

clauses.translation: and they breached the walls of my towers
and they defiled all the oils

lines.hebrew: וּמִנּוֹתַר קַנְקַנִּים, נַעֲשָׂה נֵס לַשּׁוֹשַׁנִּים,
lines.translation: and from the remnant of the flasks a miracle was performed for the lilies,

clauses.translation: and from the remnant of the flasks
a miracle was performed for the lilies

lines.hebrew: בְּנֵי בִינָה יְמֵי שְׁמוֹנָה, קָבְעוּ שִׁיר וּרְנָנִים.
lines.translation: men of understanding, [for] eight days, established song and joyous songs.

clauses.translation: men of understanding, [for] eight days
established song and joyous songs

lines.hebrew: חֲשׂוֹף זְרוֹעַ קָדְשֶׁךָ, וְקָרֵב קֵץ הַיְשׁוּעָה,
lines.translation: Bare the arm of Your holiness, and bring near the end [time] of salvation,

clauses.translation: Bare the arm of Your holiness
and bring near the end [time] of salvation

lines.hebrew: נְקֹם נִקְמַת עֲבָדֶיךָ, מֵאֻמָּה הָרְשָׁעָה,
lines.translation: avenge the vengeance of Your servants from the wicked nation,

clauses.translation: avenge the vengeance of Your servants
from the wicked nation

lines.hebrew: כִּי אָרְכָה לָנוּ הַשָּׁעָה, וְאֵין קֵץ לִימֵי הָרָעָה,
lines.translation: for the hour has grown long for us, and there is no end to the days of evil,

clauses.translation: for the hour has grown long for us
and there is no end to the days of evil

lines.hebrew: דְּחֵה אַדְמוֹן בְּצֵל צַלְמוֹן, הָקֵם לָנוּ רוֹעִים שִׁבְעָה.
lines.translation: push away the Red One into the shadow of Tsalmon, raise up for us seven shepherds.

clauses.translation: push away the Red One into the shadow of Tsalmon
raise up for us seven shepherds
